addressing.note: Addresses are the hex word addresses sent as 'first WORD address' in the function 03 request, so they go on the wire unchanged.

notes: Double-word values (UD_WORD/SD_WORD) are sent most significant word first; the protocol notes the meter can be set to big endian, little endian or swapped words, so check that setting if values look wrong.

Left out: power and energy registers whose unit is footnote (3) or (4); their scale depends on the CT x VT ratio (for example W/100 below a ratio product of 5000). The 0x15xx/0x17xx blocks give the same quantities in fixed units (W, var, Wh plus MWh).
Left out: setup parameters, device configuration words, the per-slot data areas, and any row whose printed unit does not fit the quantity (for example apparent power printed in W).
Energy in fixed units is split in two double words: a low part in Wh (varh) and a high part in MWh (Mvarh); total = high x 1,000,000 + low.

Left out: the printed last-harmonic addresses 0x72E4 and 0x7364 for phase 2 and 3 current, because they break the two-word step used everywhere else in the harmonic tables (0x72E2/0x7362 would be expected).

registers.name: 3-phase: sector of power factor (cap or ind)

integration.summary: Read holding registers (function 03) from 0x1000 for voltages and currents in mV/mA, and from 0x1500 (or 0x1700) for signed powers and energies in fixed units. Double words are high word first.
integration.enable: Set the address, baud rate and parity on the meter (both are programmable). Only functions 03 and 0x10 are used. Setup writes need the unlock key 0x5AA5 written to 0x2700 first.
quirks: Only functions 03 and 0x10 are supported (no function 04).
A single request may ask for at most 240 bytes of data.
Voltages and currents are in mV and mA.
setup: Baud rate and parity are programmable on the device; 8 data bits and 1 stop bit.
gotchas: Power registers in the 0x10xx block change scale with the CT/VT ratio; prefer the 0x15xx block.

model: Nemo D4-Le with Rogowski coil input (KRNEMOD4)
applies_to: IME Nemo D4-Le for Rogowski coils, code KRNEMOD4, per protocol PR140 (software 1.01).
summary: Rogowski-coil version of the Nemo D4-Le DIN-rail meter with an RS-485 Modbus/JBUS port. Voltages and currents are integers in mV/mA; a fixed-unit block gives signed powers, power factors and Wh/MWh energy counters.
